scope: Known reference, command and actual observation feature extraction only; no reference prediction/tracking, no second-block or report changes. Preserve existing duration_fusion and original CPOP/LABS controls.
development: Previous known-only tests/validation/stress are now seen development for NEW state/event models; old adopted model and scientific results remain unchanged. New independent validation/test follow freezing.
event_training: Known-only whole-task response classifier, balanced classes,10x weight on true <=60s response tasks; no blanket isolated-point rule. Every rejected true response counts as a miss.
state_training: Observed raw, CPOP and multiscale context; target latent threshold states for controlled training only. Median filters are FEATURES, not replacement observations. Two-state Viterbi with fixed original short positive support and clear gaps; no minimum segment duration.
mixed_anomaly: Additional paired mixed-artifact condition:1..3 independently positioned bursts, width1/2/4 bins, +/-0.25..1.0kW, constructed independently of truth and response location. Evaluated separately as well as overall.

selection_gates.no_extra_true_gap_fill: Use explicit-gap longest-duration MAE noninferiority instead of unchanged structural-mask count; direct functional estimates are evaluated as durations, not a fabricated new mask.

labels: No actual-response forecasts; complete known meter trajectories are inputs. Controlled latent labels only for training/evaluation. No field accuracy claim. All failed candidates retained and final test not tuned.
method: Known-only physical-change evidence plus direct duration residual calibration. Complete observed trajectories are inputs, not future-response forecasting. No point replacement, no minimum segment duration.
event_target: Any physical response in controlled labels (peak>0.04kW), NOT whether it crosses0.15kW. This prevents weak real actions being trained as anomaly negatives.
